name: depscan
description: OWASP dep-scan toolkit for coding agents: scan source projects and container images for vulnerabilities, triage findings, manage the vulnerability database, and produce VEX and CSAF documents.

lockfile_reminder.title: Lockfile reminder
lockfile_reminder.description: Remind Claude that the last scan is stale after it edits a lockfile or dependency manifest.

vdb_home.title: Vulnerability database directory
vdb_home.description: Directory for the vulnerability database, used as VDB_HOME when the skills run depscan. Leave empty to use the dep-scan default.

vdb_flavor.title: Vulnerability database flavor
vdb_flavor.description: Value for --vdb-flavor and depscan vdb download --flavor: full, app-only, app-extended, app-10y or app-10y-extended. Leave empty for the dep-scan default.

cdxgen_cmd.title: cdxgen command
cdxgen_cmd.description: How dep-scan starts cdxgen, used as CDXGEN_CMD when the skills run a scan. Leave empty to use the cdxgen on PATH.

runtime.title: Preferred runtime
runtime.description: Enter local to run the depscan CLI from PATH, or container to run the ghcr.io/owasp-dep-scan/dep-scan image. Leave empty for local.
